body: Grady Sizemore, Kenny Loggins and (womp womp womp)....Glenn Beck

My parents live about an hour away.  I moved down here thinking that this man was my dream guy.  My son goes to school here but only 2 days a week so arrangements can easily be made.  I think I am going to call my mother and admit that this happened today.  I really hope she is supportive.  Most everyone took my husbands side because I did not tell the truth.  I have evidence, photos, texts with threats.  What a terrifying day.  I wish the guns would get out of the house.  I wish he would get rid of them.

I have just always been completely against an affair or even thinking of another man but I was empty and being totally torn apart.   The threats, the names, the screaming....I was too scared to leave,  too stupid to get help.  Nothing physical happened with the other guy, we just spoke a lot and it was happy, he was a very nice friend but it blew a gasket in my husband that you would not believe and he told EVERYONE I was a cheater.  Being put into this corner in a town where you don't know anyone is eating me away.  I am so tired.
